run_boost_build_stage_test: run the Boost.Build stage test script to verify staging of libraries, headers, and auxiliary files
test_stage_location_property: test the stage rule with variant-specific location properties for debug and release builds
test_stage_dependency_traversal: test that stage traverses dependencies and stages linked libraries alongside executables
test_install_source_root: test the install rule with install-source-root to preserve or strip relative source paths
test_stage_custom_suffix: test that stage preserves custom target suffixes registered via type.set-generated-target-suffix
